start_local_inference: start a local model inference server using uvicorn on port 8000 for a given Hugging Face model
run_docker_inference: run a Docker container for model inference with optional GPU support for a Hugging Face model
show_available_frameworks: show all available Docker frameworks and their supported pipeline tasks from the docker_images directory
create_docker_image: create a Docker image with a random tag for a given framework from the docker_images directory
resolve_model_task_framework: resolve the task and framework for a Hugging Face model by querying the Hugging Face Hub API
